mapper.update: UPDATE t_generation_task SET status = 'TIMEOUT', error_code = 'SUBMISSION_INTERRUPTED', error_message = '提交中断或超时，请先检查厂商任务与账单，再决定是否重新生成', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_type = 'VIDEO' AND status = 'SUBMITTING' AND deleted = 0 AND created_at < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL #{timeoutMinutes} MINUTE)

SELECT model_code, COUNT(*) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS succeeded_count, COALESCE(SUM(total_cost), 0) AS total_cost, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN billed_duration ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_video_seconds, AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN total_elapsed_ms END) AS avg_elapsed_ms FROM t_generation_task

AND user_id = #{userId}
GROUP BY model_code ORDER BY total_cost DESC
